profile.headline: Sr. MTS, Software Engineer at PayPal | Payments & FinTech | AI-first Software Engineering
profile.summary:
Sr. MTS software engineer on PayPal's Xoom team, working in payments and FinTech. I design and build high-integrity software: clean architecture, strong test coverage, and production-grade reliability.

Quality is central to how I work, with a high standard for readability, correctness, and maintainability, backed by disciplined refactoring and heavy use of tests (often TDD-style). I'm especially strong at decomposing complex problems into clear layers, modules, and object-oriented designs that teams can extend for years, including modernizing existing platforms and improving maintainability over time.

I'm effective across the full SDLC, from clarifying requirements and shaping solutions, through implementation and testing, to production rollout and operational support. I stay hands-on with the infrastructure that enables software delivery and quality, including CI/CD, test automation, and platform tooling. I lead in Agile environments by driving execution through well-shaped stories, sprints, and clear engineering ownership, and I enjoy leading engineering teams to deliver consistently.

I've been on the Xoom team since 2007, and earlier in my career I worked at Zero G Software (startup) and Digeo. That mix of startup pace and PayPal scale has shaped how I build: move fast, keep quality high, and design for the long term.

I'm AI-first in how I work day to day, using modern AI tools to accelerate implementation, testing, and debugging while keeping engineering judgment and code review quality front and center.
